_comment_team: Set to your assigned team number (1-20) to enable public target validation. Leave null for internal-only use. Team 17: N = 20 + 17 = 37.
_comment_internal_targets: Five fixed server addresses from the packet inventory. Service checks are disabled by default until discovery confirms port assignments. Dynamic ports require discovery.
_comment_public_targets: Team 17 public targets (N=37): 172.25.37.10, .15, .20, .100, .120. Exclude core infrastructure (172.31.37.1), shared egress (172.31.37.2), and all other teams' addresses. Do not scan DHCP workstations.
_comment_tcp_ports: Disabled TCP candidates only: FTP 21; SSH 22; mail 25/465/587/110/143/993/995; AD DNS TCP 53, Kerberos 88/464, RPC 135, LDAP 389/636/3268/3269, SMB 445; SQL 1433; Splunk 8000/8089. Discover dynamic RPC and named SQL instance ports separately. UDP DNS, Kerberos and SQL Browser UDP 1434 require separate tools; never infer their health from TCP.
_comment_infrastructure_exclusions: Core infrastructure (172.31.37.1), shared egress (172.31.37.2), and unknown DHCP workstations are excluded from scan targets per environment.md constraints.
_comment_http_checks: Add after confirming endpoints and TLS trust prerequisites. Example HTTP: {"url": "http://172.20.240.10/", "expected_status": 200, "expected_content": "Welcome"}. Example HTTPS/SNI (certificate issued to virtual-host name): {"url": "https://172.20.240.10/", "sni_hostname": "gateway.netlab.local", "expected_status": 200, "expected_content": "Welcome"}. No credentials in URLs. Redirects are never followed; response bodies are not stored. Certificate validation is enabled by default.
